prompt: Create a simple childlike acrylic or crayon-style illustration of a cute koala hanging from a horizontal tree branch with both arms. Use a bright cyan-blue sky background with exactly 2 blocky white clouds, one larger cloud on the left edge and one smaller cloud near the right-center. The koala is centered slightly left, gray with a rounded body, round head, large round ears with pale cream inner ear patches, oval white eyes with black pupils, a large vertical black oval nose, a small smiling mouth, and two bent legs with small feet. Show exactly 2 gray hands gripping the branch from above, each with small dark claw marks. On the right side, include a thick brown tree trunk rising vertically and splitting into branches at the top, with a horizontal branch extending left across the upper third of the image. Add exactly 3 green leafy clusters: one attached to the far left end of the branch, one small cluster near the lower right side of the trunk, and one partial cluster on the far right edge. Style everything with thick uneven black outlines, visible brush texture, flat bold colors, slightly rough hand-painted edges, and a playful preschool picture-book look. Use a landscape 4:3 composition, no text, no realistic shading, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅欢快的儿童风格插图，描绘 一只考拉 用双臂挂在水平的树枝上，位置略微偏左。考拉拥有圆润的灰色身体、带有奶油色内耳的大圆耳朵、白色大圆眼配黑色瞳孔、一个巨大的垂直黑色椭圆形鼻子、一张微笑着的小嘴、两条向外抬起的短腿，以及抓着树枝的细小爪子。使用明亮的青蓝色天空作为背景，并添加恰好 2 朵块状白云，左边缘一朵较大的云，右侧一朵较小的云。在右侧放置一根粗壮的棕色树干，垂直向上并在顶部附近分叉，其中一根水平树枝向左延伸至图像上三分之一处。添加恰好 3 簇绿色叶子：树枝最左端一簇圆形的叶子、树干右下边缘一簇小的叶子，以及树干旁右下方中心附近一簇小的叶子。整幅图像采用手工制作的学龄前海报或油画棒绘画风格：粗犷且不均匀的黑色轮廓、可见的蜡笔或颜料质感、简单的平涂色彩、略显歪斜的形状、俏皮的比例，无文字，无写实感，采用 4:3 横向构图。
